title: Answer: takes no position on space, no cortical area is the seat

statements.text: The theory takes no position on space as such. On where consciousness is in the brain, it follows the thalamocortical tradition in which no specific cortical area is the seat and the interplay with the thalamus matters, and it is neutral on anterior versus posterior cortex.

sources.quote: there is no specific area of the cortex that is related to consciousness: it is the interplay with the thalamus that matters
DIT focuses more strongly on the cellular basis of consciousness
